verdict.rationale: Casium documents petition preparation and filing as its core service. It describes "a team preparing your petition in parallel" and says "best-in-class attorneys file your visas" and "licensed attorneys review and sign every filing." It positions itself as a licensed law firm and service partner in one. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence binder assembly, drafting of expert and support letters, form preparation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end service.
